description.value: This study investigated emotion regulation and neural activity associated with Machiavellianism during a cognitive reappraisal task using emotionally evocative pictures.

spans.text: We used brain-imaging techniques to investigate emotion regulation in Machiavellianism at a neuropsychological level.
